content: ˚क्षेपेण (= अकस्मात्) ‘with a (hurried) toss of the curtain’, frequently occurring as a stage direction and denoting precipitate entrance on the stage which arises from fear, hurry, agitation <ab>&c.</ab>, as when a character tossing up the curtain suddenly enters without the usual introduction ततः प्रविशति <ab>&c.</ab>
